notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact you control, adding {C}{C}.
Ich-Tekik triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and each Golem you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the remaining Animation Module triggers, choosing not to pay.
 Repeat.
